en.before: Clause 6.1.3 d) requires the organization to produce a Statement of Applicability that contains:
en.after: Clause 6.1.3 d) requires a Statement of Applicability holding:
- **the controls determined necessary** (6.1.3 b) and c))

en.before: - **whether the necessary controls are implemented or not**
- **the justification for excluding any of the Annex A controls**
en.after: - **why any Annex A control is excluded**

en.before: Notice what the first element points at. *The necessary controls, see 6.1.3 b) and c)* - the controls determined from the treatment options and checked against Annex A. **The SoA is downstream of a decision**, and its first element is a reference to where that decision was made.
en.after: Notice what the first element points at. *The controls determined necessary, 6.1.3 b) and c)* - the controls determined from the treatment options and checked against Annex A. **The SoA is downstream of a decision**, and its first element is a reference to where that decision was made.

en.before: { "id": "b", "text": "Nonconformity: clause 6.1.3 d) requires the SoA to contain the justification for excluding any of the Annex A controls, and that element is absent." },
en.after: { "id": "b", "text": "Nonconformity: clause 6.1.3 d) requires the SoA to say why any Annex A control is excluded, and that element is absent." },

en.before: - b) **ensure these persons are competent** on the basis of appropriate education, training, or experience
en.after: - b) **ensure those people are competent**, on the strength of suitable education, training or experience

en.before: - c) where applicable, **take actions to acquire** the necessary competence, **and evaluate the effectiveness** of the actions taken
en.after: - c) where applicable, **act to acquire the competence needed, and evaluate how well those actions worked**

en.before: **c) has a second half people miss: evaluate the effectiveness of the actions taken.** Sending someone on a course is the action. Establishing that it worked is the requirement.
en.after: **c) has a second half people miss: evaluating how well those actions worked.** Sending someone on a course is the action. Establishing that it worked is the requirement.

en.before: Clause 7.3 requires that **persons doing work under the organization's control** shall be aware of:
en.after: Clause 7.3 requires that **anyone working under the organization's control** shall be aware of the following:

en.before: - b) their **contribution to the effectiveness** of the ISMS, including the benefits of improved information security performance
en.after: - b) how they **contribute to the ISMS's effectiveness**, including the benefits of better information security performance

en.before: **Who is covered.** *Persons doing work under the organization's control* is wider than employees. Contractors, temporary staff and - depending on the arrangement - some supplier personnel do work under the organization's control. An awareness programme covering only the payroll is narrower than the clause.
en.after: **Who is covered.** *Anyone working under the organization's control* is wider than employees. Contractors, temporary staff and - depending on the arrangement - some supplier personnel do work under the organization's control. An awareness programme covering only the payroll is narrower than the clause.
**And one sentence of clause 7.5 people skip:**
Its normative body, in full, as ISO/IEC 27001:2022 now carries it:

en.before: **The organization shall determine whether climate change is a relevant issue.**
en.after: **The organization shall determine whether climate change is, for it, a relevant issue.**

en.before: - Annex A 5.9 requires an inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners.
en.after: - Annex A 5.9 requires an inventory of information and associated assets, with their owners.

en.after: { "id": "r2", "text": "The organization must set the objectives, criteria and scope of each individual audit." },
